newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sanonda to list 100 mln B shares on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Sanonda to list 100 mln B shares on Thursday.

text.p: China's Sanonda Co Ltd will list 100 million B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on Thursday, a company statement in Thursday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
The pesticide maker last month issued the foreign currency B shares at HK$3.48 per share, giving a price/earnings ratio of 8.78 times based on forecasted 1997 net profits on a fully diluted basis.

Pre-exceptional net profit is expected to be more than 114 million yuan and the company will use the proceeds to update production technology, Sanonda has said in an offer prospectus, adding J&A Securities Ltd has been appointed as listing sponsor.
Sanonda has named Indosuez W.I. Carr Securities Ltd as the international coordinator, the statement said.
Analysts said they expected Sanonda to perform strongly on its debut.
"Investors are in favour of low-price, high-growth new shares," an analyst at Central-South Securities told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Sanonda, which also has A shares listed in Shenzhen, posted net profits of 77.61 million yuan in 1996 against 50.36 million yuan in 1995 based on Chinese accounting standards.
After the B share offer, the company has a total of 281.96 million shares made up of 84.73 million state shares, 97.23 million shares held by individuals and 100 million B shares, the statement said.
